steps.title: Welcome to the yard
steps.text: Six people hold this schoolyard against the dead. I'll show you how, one small step at a time. First, look around: drag to pan (or press W A S D) and scroll to zoom.

steps.title: Give an order
steps.text: Click Ruth's picture at the top to select her. Then right-click the ground nearby: she walks there and waits for you.
steps.goal: select Ruth, then right-click the ground

steps.title: Hand her back
steps.text: Whoever you order about stays where you put them. Press R, or the Release button, and Ruth goes back to her usual work.

steps.title: Your stores
steps.text: Top left is everything you own. Food and water are counted in days. Repairs spend scrap, shots spend ammo, bandages spend medicine. Nothing refills itself unless someone goes out and fetches it.

steps.title: A trip to town
steps.text: Food and water will run out, so someone has to fetch more. Click Ana, press G, choose the houses and press Send. She is back around four in the afternoon.
steps.goal: select Ana, press G, choose a place, then Send
steps.dialog_text: In the box, click the houses, then press Send.

steps.title: Posts on the wall
steps.text: At night the crew shoots from the walkways. Select Hector and press P: he climbs a ladder to his post and holds it.

steps.title: Mend the wall
steps.text: The school bus on the north wall is at 45%. Click it, then press F. A builder repairs it, and every ten points of wall cost one scrap.
steps.goal: click the bus, then press F

steps.title: The lookout speaks
steps.text: Marcus watches the road. Each day at 17:00 he says how many are coming tonight, and from where. It shows in the clock. Plan your guns around it.
steps.wait_text: Ana is due back at 16:00 and Marcus reports at 17:00. Press 3 to speed time up, 1 for normal speed, Space to pause.

steps.title: Shots cost ammo
steps.text: Walkers at the gate! Click Marcus: the ring is how far he shoots, the pips are the rounds in his rifle. Every shot comes out of the Ammo store.
steps.goal: select Marcus and watch the Ammo number

goals.text: watch the Ammo number go down

steps.wait_text: At 19:00 the bell rings. Everyone goes to their post and the dead come, a few more each night. Press 3 to speed time up.

steps.title: Where the guns reach
steps.text: Press V. Every wall piece shows how many guns cover it from the night posts: red none, amber one, green two or more. Keep your guns where the dead will come.

steps.title: Ring the alarm
steps.text: Four more are coming from the north east. Click the main gate, where the guns reach, and press L. The alarm draws the dead to it. It costs 3 scrap.
steps.goal: click the main gate, then press L

steps.title: A scratch
steps.text: Walt was scratched. A wound bleeds until someone bandages it. Ana does it on her own, and it costs one medicine. Look for the red mark on his picture.

steps.title: A fever
steps.text: Hector has a fever. Left alone, it turns him into one of the dead. Click him and press T: Ana treats it for two medicine. X sends someone out for good: not today.

steps.title: Save your game
steps.text: Press F5 to save wherever you are, and F9 to load it again. A real run also saves itself at every dawn.

steps.title: The worktable
steps.text: Ammo runs out first in a long game. Click Dez and press M: he turns scrap into ammo at the worktable, eight rounds for each scrap, until the bell.
steps.wait_text: Hold the wall until first light at 06:30. The dead drift away then. Press 3 to hurry the night along.

steps.title: Well done
steps.text: You know how to give orders, hold a post, mend a wall, keep the stores, send a trip and tend the hurt. The ? button lists every key. A real run lasts thirty nights. Ready?
steps.skipped_text: No problem. The ? button lists every key, and you can play Orientation Day again from the main menu whenever you like.
